title: Mace Music+
description: Plays a song the user imports, if the user is holding a mace.
body:
**Mace Music - by: Fluffui**
Plays a song the user imports if user is holding a mace. Mod tested on **1.21.11**

**Requirements**
- Must have the resource pack (comes with the mod) for custom music.
- Mod Menu, for configurations - Uploading your own music

**Guide - Common Issues**

Q: Why is my song not playing?

   A: - 1. Your .ogg file is broken.
   
   A: - 2. Reload/Relaunch your Minecraft or Reload your resource packs.

Q: The Mod just doesn't work!

   A: - 1. Your settings are configured wrong, default are: 
              Mace Hold: 5s | No-Hit timeout: 500s | Cooldown 10s
              
   A: - 2. You are on a unsupported version of Minecraft. 1.21.11 Is the officialy supported version for Ver 3.1

**New Features in V3.1**
- Added Mod Menu support
- Keybind to stop music.
- Options for how long to hold the mace before it starts, time before stopping if you haven't hit a mob in __ seconds, and a volume bar.
- Added a feature to import songs.
- Fixed song deleting feature.

**Future Features**
- More version support.

Any issues, please add them in the github
Github link: https://github.com/Fluffui/Mace-Music-Mod
